'''Probability and statistics''' are two closely related fields in mathematics that are sometimes combined for academic purposes.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-05-introduction-to-probability-and-statistics-spring-2022/resources/mit18_05_s22_probability_pdf/ |title=Introduction to Probability and Statistics |website=[[MIT OpenCourseWare]] |first1=Jeremy |last1=Orloff |first2=Jonathan |last2=Bloom |date=Spring 2022 |access-date=2025-01-21}}</ref> They are covered in multiple articles and lists:

* [[Probability]]
* [[Statistics]]
* [[Glossary of probability and statistics]]
* [[Notation in probability and statistics]]
* [[Timeline of probability and statistics]]

Publications named for both fields include the following:
* ''[[Brazilian Journal of Probability and Statistics]]''
* ''[[Counterexamples in Probability and Statistics]]''
* ''[[Probability and Mathematical Statistics]]''
* ''[[Theory of Probability and Mathematical Statistics]]''
